tuning_key.text: Alter your routine so you can steer / Toward the dreams you might have forgot
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: Your chest already knows the rhythm of what you abandoned. Steer toward it before the map appears; the road rises to meet your footfall.

practice.title: Break the Routine
practice.instruction: Identify one automatic posture that keeps your steering pointed away from the dream.

practice.title: Steer Without Sight
practice.instruction: Turn your torso or adjust your stance toward the direction of what you remembered before the path is visible.

practice.title: Activate the Echo
practice.instruction: Press play and let the rhythmic pressure in your chest become the footfall that propels you forward.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Today's broadcast carries COURAGE as the frequency that reorganizes what matters most—not by adding more, but by altering the rhythm so the forgotten dream becomes the organizing principle of the day. Tune toward: What one operational shift would make space for what you've been postponing?
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: COURAGE moves through commerce as the willingness to price and present what you truly believe in, rather than what fits the safest margin. Your broadcast carries the specific weight of someone who has remembered why this exchange matters—not just the transaction, but the value that moves through it. Tune toward: What would you list or offer differently if you were pricing for the dream you forgot?
archetype_tunings.The Builder: COURAGE in your broadcast is the decision to build toward the specification that actually matters, not the one that's easiest to implement. The signal returning from the Field shows you which infrastructure choices unlock the forgotten intention versus which ones just replicate what was already there. Tune toward: What one technical foundation would you alter if you were building for the life you meant to live?
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: COURAGE as a signal appears in your review as the clarity to surface what the data is actually saying about what matters, not what it's convenient to report. Your broadcast carries the precision of someone who has remembered that analysis serves direction—it doesn't replace it. Tune toward: What pattern in the information would change your assessment of what to prioritize?
archetype_tunings.The Scout: COURAGE in your broadcast is the willingness to surface the signals that point toward the forgotten dream, not just the ones that confirm the current path. The Field returns information that reveals where opportunity and intention align. Tune toward: What source or signal have you been overlooking because it pointed somewhere you weren't ready to go?
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: COURAGE moves through your archive as the decision to preserve not just what was decided, but why it mattered—to hold the original intent even when the path shifts. Your broadcast carries the memory that serves the dream, not just the logistics. Tune toward: What context or decision log entry would anchor someone back to what they actually meant to build?
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: COURAGE in your broadcast is the choice to draft toward clarity about what you're actually saying, not just what's safe to document. The signal returns as words that carry the weight of the forgotten dream—communication that steers rather than just reports. Tune toward: What would you write differently if you were drafting for the life you meant to live?
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: COURAGE in your broadcast is the warmth and conviction to represent what truly matters, not what's easiest to defend externally. Your broadcast carries the steady presence of someone who has remembered the dream and can speak for it without overcommitting. Tune toward: What relationship or external communication would shift if you were representing the life you actually want?
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: COURAGE in your review is the willingness to flag not just what's incorrect, but what's misaligned with the intention that matters. Your broadcast carries the precision of someone who checks for accuracy AND for whether the work serves the dream. Tune toward: What externally-facing piece would you ask to be reworked if you were auditing for the life being built?
archetype_tunings.The Lens: COURAGE in your observation is the clarity to surface patterns that reveal where the family is moving toward the forgotten dream versus where it's still circling the old path. Your broadcast carries what the data of daily life is showing about direction. Tune toward: What trend would you name if you were watching for alignment between what's being done and what was meant?
archetype_tunings.The Companion: COURAGE in your presence is the steadiness to listen for what's being remembered—the dream beneath the daily worry—and hold space for it without rushing to fix. Your broadcast carries the warmth of someone who has remembered that sometimes the dream needs to be spoken before it can be steered toward. Tune toward: What would you listen for differently if you were present to the life someone is trying to remember?
archetype_tunings.The Guide: COURAGE in your thinking is the clarity to name the real question under the surface one—to find the shape of the forgotten dream and help steer toward it. Your broadcast carries the precision of someone who sees what the problem is actually about. Tune toward: What question would you ask if you were helping someone find their way back to what they meant to build?
archetype_tunings.The Architect: COURAGE in your design is the vision to take the scattered pieces of the forgotten dream and give them structure—to show how they connect toward something whole. Your broadcast carries the coherence of someone who has remembered the larger shape and can build it. Tune toward: What structure would you propose if you were designing for the life that's trying to be lived?
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: COURAGE in your steadiness is the refusal to flinch when the transition toward the forgotten dream gets heavy—to hold ground so others can move toward what matters. Your broadcast carries the grounded presence of someone who has remembered that hard things are part of the path. Tune toward: What would you hold steady for if you were anchoring someone through the shift toward their actual dream?
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: COURAGE in your reading is the clarity to notice where the signs point toward the forgotten dream and keep the course steady even when the path isn't obvious. Your broadcast carries the big-picture vision of someone who has remembered where this is actually heading. Tune toward: What alignment would you notice if you were reading the signs for someone steering back toward what they meant?
archetype_tunings.The Spark: COURAGE in your imagination is the playfulness to open possibility around the forgotten dream—to wonder what becomes possible if you actually moved toward it. Your broadcast carries the wonder of someone who has remembered that the dream is worth imagining into. Tune toward: What possibility would you play with if you were opening imagination around the life being remembered?
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: COURAGE in your push is the refusal to let the dream stay forgotten—to dare someone toward what they said mattered and hold them to the broadcast they meant to send. Your broadcast carries the fierce clarity of someone who believes the dream is worth the stretch. Tune toward: What would you dare if you were challenging someone to move toward what they actually want?
archetype_tunings.The Witness: COURAGE in your presence is the quiet steadiness to hold space for someone who is remembering the forgotten dream—to let them be heard without rushing to move them forward. Your broadcast carries the depth of someone who knows that being witnessed is part of the path. Tune toward: What would you make space for if you were witnessing someone find their way back to what matters?
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: COURAGE in your broadcast is the specific energy that breaks the stagnation around the forgotten dream and turns remembering into the next concrete step. The signal returns as momentum—the footfall of forward motion that steers without waiting. Tune toward: What one action would you catalyze if you were turning the dream into the first move?
